notes:
v4.6.127 — Separate paper/live bots + Alpaca sub-portfolios

🔀 Paper and live bots run SEPARATELY (no more 'migration'). Switching to LIVE no longer moves your paper bots — paper keeps running on paper while you start independent bots on your live account, the same way Alpaca vs IBKR already work. Cloud bots are now keyed by paper/live so the same bot can run on both at once.

🧩 Alpaca sub-portfolios: you can now pair several bots to ONE Alpaca API key. In Tools → Alpaca API Keys, put the same key in multiple slots and set an Alloc % on each — each bot trades only its slice of the shared account, exactly like the IBKR allocation structure. Leave Alloc blank to give a bot its own dedicated account (unchanged).

Paper stays the default; live needs your funded account + live keys. Update via the in-app banner.
